# AI-augmented foundations

> Whether the family's setup is complete and whether it converges: can a tree or graph of topics encode every problem at a cognitive cost a person bears; how fast a project reaches a result, acceptable or optimal, and what an optimum is. Scope only; the review is not started.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [AI-augmented foundations](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository
